covers.title: 야행퇴마
covers.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Finished flat front cover of a Korean wuxia novel series, portrait 2:3, high resolution, not a book mockup.
Image 1 is ONLY the established series style reference; create NEW artwork, do not copy its scene or objects. Traditional East Asian ink-wash and restrained watercolor on warm ivory fibrous paper. Expressive dry-brush edges, delicate mist, intricate ancient architecture dissolving into unpainted paper. Match the series layout: four large traditional Chinese calligraphy characters stacked vertically at upper left, smaller legible Korean subtitle in ONE vertical column down the right margin. Black title ink with restrained deep cinnabar within brush strokes. Small Korean series label along bottom. Generously space all text and leave quiet paper behind it. No additional words.
Avoid red sun, red moon, any red celestial orb, generic round enso decoration, photorealism, anime, 3D, neon, Western fantasy armor, watermark, arbitrary plum blossoms. Red sun belongs exclusively to a different character's power and must not be used here. Distinct composition and atmosphere while maintaining a cohesive collectible cover series.
Scene: an ancient narrow village lane at midnight, crooked tile eaves, distant mountain temple, pine silhouettes. One solitary anonymous wandering exorcist in the middle distance walks toward a tiny warm lantern. Long eerie nonhuman shadows across wet stone and ghostlike silhouettes barely suggested through ink mist, not a crowd of explicit monsters. Foreground yellowed Daoist paper talismans curl on a cracked stone bridge. Transparent deep muted indigo-grey ink creates darkness, ivory paper margins remain bright. A pale ivory crescent moon partly obscured by mist, never red. Quiet supernatural dread and contemplative beauty, sophisticated asymmetrical composition.
Main title verbatim "夜行退魔", stacked 夜 / 行 / 退 / 魔.
Subtitle verbatim "밤에는 사람이 아닌 것이 걷는다".
Small label verbatim "천고 · 제3부".
Ensure precise Korean and traditional Chinese text with no omitted characters.

Scene: Seomun Geol is a steadfast imposing guardian at the base of colossal weathered imperial palace doors. Three-quarter view, figure mid-right, weary yet unbroken, both swords lowered, cloak swept into expressive rough ink strokes. Temple stairs curve upward behind him into pale mist, centuries of weathering on stone, fragments of battle standards in the lower foreground, faint amber light between the closed doors. His oath outlives death, expressed through duty, ancient stone and scale, no gore. Black, warm grey, ivory and restrained dark cinnabar cloth accents. Quiet left paper for title and clear subtitle margin.
